subject: Reseller rebate tiers and minimum commit clarification for private offer
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nebulacloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebulacloud.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification on reseller rebate tiers for Private Offer (Nebula RFP)

Hi Hannah / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — NebulaCloud is excited about Redwood for inference. Our procurement team is working the private offer paperwork and we need to verify two items before we proceed to DocuSign:

1) Reseller/rebate tiers: your Marketplace P.O. doc references a 10–20% channel margin band and a separate downstream rebate schedule — can you confirm how those interact at the SKU level (embeddings vs. generation)?
2) Minimum annual commit: the RFP lists a 150k ARR minimum for the standard private offer; is there flexibility for a 90k commit if Nebula guarantees a 6 month ramp and provides a reseller co-sell plan?

I've attached the RFP and our procurement timeline for context. Procurement is targeting signature by 7/7.

Appreciate a short note on the two items — we can jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
NebulaCloud
Attachment: Nebula_RFP_Attachment.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on reseller rebate tiers for Private Offer (Nebula RFP)

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick responses inline, and next steps below.

1) SKU-level interaction: short answer — rebate programs apply on top of the channel commission. Practically:
- Marketplace list price (what Nebula pays) -> channel commission paid to the reseller (typ. 8–18% depending on tier)
- Rebates are calculated against billed revenue post-commission; we can apply tiered rebates per SKU family (e.g., embeddings, chat/generation, fine-tune).

We typically separate embeddings at a higher margin floor because of lower compute cost; generation SKUs often land in the standard tier. I can attach a simple tier mapping.

2) Minimum commit: we can be flexible. For a 90k commit with a documented 6-month ramp and a formal co-sell plan, we can offer a 12-month private offer but we would require:
- A 6-month ramp milestone schedule (monthly acceptance targets)
- A 5% uplift on list price for first 3 months if the ramp misses by >25% (to protect unit economics)

Next steps: I'll loop Karthik for the concrete rebate tiers and a draft private offer summary for your procurement team. If helpful, let's do a 20-min sync today at 2pm PT.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Director, Channel GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Clarification on reseller rebate tiers for Private Offer (Nebula RFP)

Folks — drafting the SKU-level rebate proposal per Hannah's ask. Summary below (numbers illustrative; subject to legal/finance sign-off):

Proposed tiered rebate schedule (post-commission):
- Tier A (annualized billed revenue > $500k): 8% rebate on generation SKUs, 12% on embeddings
- Tier B ($250k–$500k): 6% generation, 9% embeddings
- Tier C ($90k–$250k): 4% generation, 6% embeddings
- Below $90k: no rebate, standard channel commission only

Channel commission guidance (paid to reseller at invoicing): base 10% (negotiable up to 18% for strategic resellers). Rebates are reconciled quarterly and issued as credit against future invoices.

Minimum commit exception for Nebula: we can accept a 90k ARR commit under these guardrails:
- 6-month ramp schedule with monthly checkpoints (we'll include acceptance metrics)
- If monthly ramp misses by >25% for two consecutive months, Redwood can apply a price uplift of 5% for subsequent invoices until catch-up

Attached is a quick calc sheet showing the waterfall (commission -> rebate -> net revenue) to validate margin impact.

Attachment: internal_revshare_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Karthik
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nebulacloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebulacloud.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on reseller rebate tiers for Private Offer (Nebula RFP)

Thanks — that layout helps. Procurement has two follow-ups before signature:

• Can Nebula get a one-time onboarding rebate (3% of first-quarter billed) to offset integration costs?
• If we commit to a 90k ARR and hit Tier C in year 1, can the channel commission be guaranteed at 12% (we want a stronger reseller incentive)?

Timeline: procurement still expects to route the PO to legal by 7/5. We're happy to sign via DocuSign once the private offer YAML and marketplace SKU mapping are final.

If you can confirm the onboarding rebate and the reseller commission guarantee (or propose a close alternative) by COB 7/2, we can keep the timetable.

Alicia
Attachment: (none)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on reseller rebate tiers for Private Offer (Nebula RFP) — Final proposal and next steps

Alicia — quick final from our side after sync with finance:

• One-time onboarding rebate: approved at 3% of Q1 billed (issued as credit in month 2 post-billing).
• Reseller commission guarantee: we can guarantee a 12% commission for Tier C for the first 12 months, conditional on a signed reseller MOU (simple one-pager) that lists co-sell activities and lead handoff SLAs.

I've attached a concise private offer summary (includes SKU mapping and waterfall example) and routed the draft to Legal for a minimal change private offer YML. Marissa will lead contracting and will follow up on the MOU template.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare MOU template and private-offer YML for procurement/legal (target 7/5).
- Alicia: confirm in reply that Nebula accepts the 6-month ramp milestones and MOU requirement.
- Karthik/Vanessa: confirm reseller contact for the MOU.

Thanks everyone — we'll aim for DocuSign ready by 7/6 to keep your 7/7 target.

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Director, Channel GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW-PO-8392-private-offer-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
